what: verification of the references cited in Hard_Zeta_AU2d3_Literature_Notes_v0.1.md
checked_by: 數學戰士「墜衡」 / AMRAL Research Lab
why_this_round_is_different: A-U.2d.3 takes exactly one external input, the Diophantine exponent rho_star = 4.1164, and derives theta_star, sigma_star and every published figure from it. Unlike the withdrawn citation in the three previous rounds, this reference is LOAD-BEARING: if it does not say what the round says it says, every exponent moves.

references.authors: Aihua Fan, Hervé Queffélec, Martine Queffélec
references.title: Old and new results on the Furstenberg sets
references.the_round_attributes_to_it: a survey reporting the Wang-Wu improvement rho <= 4.11633052 for alpha = log2/log3
references.what_it_actually_says: G. Rhin proved rho <= 7.616 for alpha = log2/log3 by Padé approximants, 'improved by Wang and Wu to rho <= 4.11633052'. It then uses rho = 4.11633052 with delta := 0.80454645 = rho/(rho+1) in its Theorem 2.1 remainder estimate for the Furstenberg set counting function.
references.verdict: the attribution is exactly right, and the exponent applies to alpha = log2/log3 as the round needs -- not to ln 3

references.cited_in_the_notes_as: Lihong Wang, Qiang Wu, *On the irrationality measure of \log_2 3*, Journal of Number Theory 142 (2014), 264-273
references.crossref_says_title: On the irrationality measure of log 3
references.FINDING: the title is misstated and the authors are reversed
references.detail: Volume, pages, year and DOI all match exactly. The title does not: the paper is 'On the irrationality measure of log 3', and the notes render it 'On the irrationality measure of log_2 3'. The published result most often quoted from it is mu(log 3) <= 5.1163051, about the natural logarithm of 3 -- a different quantity from log2/log3.
references.why_it_matters_more_than_a_typo: log 3 -> log_2 3 is precisely the substitution that would make the citation self-justifying. A reader checking whether this exponent applies to log2/log3 rather than to ln 3 finds the title already asserting it, and stops. The exponent the round uses IS about log2/log3 -- established above from Fan-Queffelec-Queffelec directly -- so the mathematics is unaffected. The citation is what fails.
references.not_established_here: whether this paper itself contains the log2/log3 exponent, or whether Fan-Queffelec-Queffelec's reference [74] is a different Wang-Wu work. The publisher's page returns 403 and the arXiv survey's bibliography was not retrievable. Volume, pages and DOI matching makes it the same paper, but its contents were not read.

references.author: Georges Rhin
references.title: Approximants de Padé et mesures effectives d'irrationalité
references.venue: Séminaire de Théorie des Nombres, Paris 1985-86
references.consistency_check: Fan-Queffelec-Queffelec independently attribute the earlier bound rho <= 7.616 for alpha to Rhin, by Padé approximants -- which is what the notes describe. Consistent.

references.author: Tong Niu
references.title: Parity vectors and paradoxical sequences in the accelerated Collatz map
references.new_this_round: the withdrawal notice names Rozier and Terracol arXiv:2502.00948v4 as already containing the enumeration, and THESE NOTES CITE ROZIER-TERRACOL TWO ENTRIES BELOW. The bundle carries both the withdrawn paper and the paper it was withdrawn in favour of, and says nothing about the relation between them.
references.withdrawal_comment_verbatim: withdrawn - Rozier and Terracol [arXiv:2502.00948v4] (April 2026) already enumerate the 593 paradoxical sequences in the accelerated Collatz map up to length 60 and identify the seven (j,q) pairs; the (46,73) mediant observation follows routinely from their data. Withdrawing to avoid duplication

references.title: Paradoxical behavior in Collatz sequences
references.verdict: cited accurately, including the Discrete Mathematics 2026 journal reference

a_hypothesis_this_check_raised_and_then_.hypothesis: that rho_star = 4.1164 was mu(ln 3) = 5.1163051 minus one, misapplied to log2/log3 -- which would have moved theta_star from 0.19545 to about 0.116 and every exponent in the round with it
a_hypothesis_this_check_raised_and_then_.how_it_arose: a web search summary reported Wu and Wang's result as mu(log 3) <= 5.1163051 and attributed rho <= 8.616 for log3/log2 to Rhin, which is close enough to the round's numbers to look like the source of a substitution
a_hypothesis_this_check_raised_and_then_.how_it_was_refuted: by reading Fan-Queffelec-Queffelec's own text, which states Rhin's bound for alpha as 7.616 (not 8.616) and Wang-Wu's improvement as 4.11633052 for the same alpha
a_hypothesis_this_check_raised_and_then_.lesson: a search summary is not a source. The hypothesis was specific, quantitative, and wrong, and only the primary text could say so.

findings: the Wu-Wang citation misstates the paper's title as 'log_2 3' when it is 'log 3', and reverses the author order; volume, pages, year and DOI are exact.
arXiv:2605.13886 (Niu) is WITHDRAWN and cited for the fourth bundle running, alongside the very paper its withdrawal notice defers to.
the exponent rho_star = 4.1164 is correctly sourced and is conservative against the cited 4.11633052 by 1737/25000000, checked as exact rationals in the gate.
